notes: The Outlaw's stable. In December 1997 it is the Outlaw, the Executive and Steel Cold: on 12 December the Outlaw and the Executive bring Steel Cold a briefcase with his name on it (the booth argues it out: "We have no proof Steel is part of their group." / "His name was on the briefcase.", wwa-1997-12-12); on 19 December the card bills the Outlaw "a part of the Executive's Club", the Outlaw says "Steel Cold and I will be watching", and when Steel Cold comes out alone the booth asks "is there a problem in the Executive Club already?" (wwa-1997-12-19). On 2 January 1998 Steel Cold is written out (an in-fiction death) and the Judge, "newcomer to The Executive's Club", takes his place (wwa-1998-01-02), the night Mr. Business is first seen with the club. From then the Outlaw, the Executive, Mr. Business and the Judge are seated together at the Saloon table (wwa-1997-01-09), and the cards speak of "the rest of the Executive's Club" and, on 23 January 1998, "all four members of the Executive's Club" (wwa-1998-01-23).
